newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TENNIS-ROMANIA BUILD ON EARLY LEAD OVER DUTCH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ROMANIA BUILD ON EARLY LEAD OVER DUTCH.

text.p: Romanian Andrei Pavel won a precious second point for his country by beating Jan Siemerink of the Netherlands as his country took a 2-0 lead in their Davis Cup world group first round tie on Friday.
Pavel, world-ranked 135th, said his passing shots had been decisive in his 6-2 6-1 4-6 6-4 win over Siemerink, ranked 21.
Siemerink said he had bowed to the fast pace which Pavel imposed throughout the match:"I was totally surprised at the speed of his play."
Earlier Adrian Voinea beat Paul Haarhuis 4-6 6-1 6-3 6-3.
Saturday's doubles will feature Pavel and Voinea against the strong Dutch team of Haarhuis and Jacco Eltingh.
